3  ORDER

Petitioners herein are sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A,
323, 504, 506 r/w 34 of IPC, and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. The case of the prosecution is that, petitioners herein subjected the defacto complainant to cruelty, both mentally and physically, and also a demand was made to bring money from the parental home.

3. Accused No.1 and respondent No.2 are present before this Court and they have filed an application under Section 320 r/w 482 of Cr.P.C., along with joint affidavit of accused No.1 and the respondent No.2-defacto complainant for compounding the offences.
4. Perusal of the application indicated that the petitioner-accused No.1 had filed a petition in M.C.No.372/2023 before the Family Court concerned for dissolving his marriage with the defacto-complainant.
The matter was referred to the Mediation Center to explore the possibility of amicable settlement between the parties.

5. The parties before the Mediation Center amicably settled the disputes among themselves, and as per the terms of the settlement, the marriage of the accused No.1 with the defacto-complainant has been dissolved mutually and permanent alimony of Rs.18 Lakh is paid to the defacto complainant-respondent No.2 and the respondent No.2- NC: 2023:KHC:43392 defacto-complainant has agreed to withdraw all the allegations made against the petitioners herein.
6. The application is placed on record.

7. Though the offences alleged are cognizable and non-compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that the parties have amicably settled their disputes among themselves, it would be a futile exercise, if the petitioners are subjected to investigation, since the probability of Police filing the charge sheet is remote and bleak in view of the settlement.
Therefore, the continuation of the investigation will be an abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The criminal petitions are allowed ii) The impugned FIR in Crime No.220/2021 registered by the Chandra Layout Police Station, Bengaluru, pending on the file of the VIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bangalore is hereby quashed.
